history.text: The Mali empire under Sundiata and Mansa Musa controlled the gold and salt trade.
Timbuktu and Djenne became centres of Islamic scholarship.
France established the colony of French Sudan.
Independence came on 22 September after the Mali Federation dissolved.
Rebellion and Islamist advance in the north triggered international intervention.

worthSeeing.title: Djenne:
worthSeeing.text: The Great Mosque, the largest mud-brick building in the world, a UNESCO site.

worthSeeing.title: Timbuktu:
worthSeeing.text: Medieval mosques and manuscript libraries at the desert's edge.

worthSeeing.title: Bandiagara Escarpment:
worthSeeing.text: Dogon villages built into a 150 km cliff, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
